info.title: ZeroGen API
info.description: Generate images and video with every model in ZeroGen from your own servers. Generated from the API's contracts by `npm run openapi` in apps/web; do not edit by hand.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The calling key and the organization's balance.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: The models an organization can run and their schemas.

tags.name: Generations
tags.description: Quote, create, read, list and cancel generations.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Upload files into the Library to use as inputs.

get.description:
The calling API key, its organization and its owner. `scopes` lists what the key can do now: its scopes that the owner's role still allows.

Needs no scope.

The organization's funds and monthly limits, shared by every member and project. A new generation's quote must fit within `availableMicroUsd`.

Needs the `account:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also report this project's monthly budget

get.description:
The models this organization can run, one entry per model and operation. Read a model to get the JSON Schema its requests follow.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: The model ID's operation segment

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search model IDs and labels, including the maker and related operations

parameters.name: frames
parameters.description: Video models accepting at least these frame slots

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Video models that can generate audio

parameters.name: referenceKind
parameters.description: Models accepting reference media of this kind

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Models per page; default 20

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One model and the JSON Schema (2020-12) that `POST /generations` validates its requests against. A deprecated model sends `Deprecation` and `Sunset`.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The company that makes the model, such as `google`

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model, such as `nano-banana-2`

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: The operation, such as `generate`

post.description:
Validates and prices a request exactly as create would, and returns the maximum charge create would reserve. Nothing starts and nothing is held.

Needs the `generations:create` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

post.description:
Validates, prices, reserves and starts one generation in a single call. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Nothing is charged unless every check passes.

Needs the `generations:create` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

200.description: The generation has ended, within the requested wait.

202.description: The generation started and has not ended yet.

get.description:
The calling key owner's generations, newest first.

Needs the `generations:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Only generations in this project

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only generations filed in this folder; needs projectId

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Generations per page; default 10

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One generation and each output's status, asset and error. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Reads never start or repeat work.

Needs the `generations:read` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The generation's ID

202.description: With `Prefer: wait`, the generation had not ended when the wait ran out.

post.description:
Stops the generation's unfinished outputs. Outputs a vendor already finished are kept and charged; cancelling a finished generation returns it unchanged. Takes no body.

Needs the `generations:cancel` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The generation's ID

post.description:
Starts an upload into the Library. PUT the file's exact bytes to the returned target, then complete the upload. With `sha256`, an identical file already in the project comes back ready, with nothing to send.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

200.description: An identical file is already in the project.

get.description:
One of the caller's uploads and, once ready, its Library asset.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

post.description:
Checks the uploaded bytes and makes them a Library asset to use as a generation input. Completing again returns the same asset. Takes no body.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

bearerAuth.description: A ZeroGen API key: zg_ for a live key, zg_test_ for a test key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes retries safe: a retry with the same key and body returns the first response for 24 hours instead of repeating the work. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: wait=N holds the response up to N seconds (at most 60) until the generation ends.

Request-Id.description: Identifies the request; quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

Location.description: Where to read the created resource.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response replays an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

Preference-Applied.description: The wait applied, such as wait=30.

Deprecation.description: When the model was deprecated, as @ followed by Unix seconds.

Sunset.description: When the deprecated model stops accepting requests (HTTP date).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or invalid: invalid_request, validation_failed, model_unavailable or input_import_failed.

Unauthorized.description: invalid_api_key: the key is missing, revoked or expired.

PaymentRequired.description: insufficient_balance or spend_limit_reached: the available balance or a spend limit cannot cover the quote. cost_limit_exceeded: the quote is above maxCostMicroUsd.

Forbidden.description: permission_denied: the key lacks the scope this endpoint needs, the request came from a browser, or the API isn't enabled for the organization.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource for this caller, including a projectId the caller can't use.

Conflict.description: idempotency_conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. idempotency_in_progress: the first request with this key hasn't finished. invalid_state: the request can't go ahead as things stand, such as a generation that needs a person's approval in ZeroGen.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is larger than 128 KB.

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limited: the key or its owner is over the rate limit, or the organization is at its running cap. Retry after Retry-After seconds.

ServiceUnavailable.description: unavailable or pricing_unavailable: API keys, billing or pricing can't be reached right now. Retry.

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

url.description: An https URL ZeroGen imports into the library before use

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

size.description: Image size: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, such as 1024x1536

parameters.description: Only the parameters the model's schema lists

maxCostMicroUsd.description: Refuse to start when the quote exceeds this amount

outputs.description: Each output's outcome, in order: succeeded, or the error code a live output can end with. Outputs left out succeed

reject.description: Create only: refuse with this live response and start nothing (402 insufficient_balance, 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, 400 model_unavailable)

delaySeconds.description: Seconds before each output ends, to rehearse polling and Prefer: wait

test.description: Test keys only: rehearse each output's outcome; live keys are refused when it is present

projectId.description: The project the outputs land in; the organization's default project when omitted. Test keys use their sandbox.

folderId.description: A folder in that project to file the outputs in; null or omitted for Unfiled

presetId.description: A naming preset in the generation's project

values.description: Field values by field ID; fields left out take the preset's defaults

projectId.description: The project to upload into; omit for the organization's default project.

folderId.description: Add the asset to this folder in the project.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file, to reuse an identical file in the project.

mode.description: test keys run on placeholder providers, charge nothing and stay in the sandbox

scopes.description: What this key can do now: its scopes that its owner's role still allows

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working; null for never

user.description: The key's owner, whom it acts as

sandbox.description: Test keys only: the project every request of the key is confined to

heldMicroUsd.description: Reserved for generations that have not settled; a hold is not a charge

availableMicroUsd.description: What a new generation's quote must fit within; it can be negative

unlimited.description: The funds check is bypassed; usage is still charged

spentMicroUsd.description: This UTC month's spend, as admission counts it

projectMonthly.description: With projectId, that project's monthly budget

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of models; null on the last page

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

requestSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /v1/generations with this model; x-roles lists each input role's accepted media and limits

projectId.description: The project that holds the outputs

resourceUri.description: Where this transport's client reads the asset, such as an MCP resource

warnings.description: What the provider ignored, such as an unused reference

upscalable.description: A final can be requested now: unexpired, with no final in progress

upscale.description: The newest final's state, or null when none was requested

finalResolution.description: That final's resolution, one the model's draft control lists

draft.description: A 480p Draft output; upscaling it makes a final with the same seed, at a resolution the model's draft control lists

state.description: held: an amount is reserved and nothing is charged yet; charged: chargedMicroUsd is the final charge; released: the hold ended with no charge; null: billing never admitted the generation, so nothing was held or charged

running: the generation has not ended; ended: it ended and the hold is still pending; needs_attention: it has stayed pending 30 minutes after ending, or 24 hours after admission with no end recorded (endedAt then stays null), so ZeroGen is looking into it

endedAt.description: When the generation ended; null while it runs or when no end was recorded

hold.description: While held, where the generation stands. It reports facts, not what settlement will do

heldMicroUsd.description: While held, the amount reserved now; it is never a charge

chargedMicroUsd.description: The final charge once charged, zero once released; it can rarely exceed the quote

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of generations; null on the last page

id.description: The upload's ID, which completes it

status.description: upload_required: PUT the bytes, then complete; ready: the asset can be used

assetId.description: Once ready, the Library asset to send as a generation input; an identical file already in the project is reused

upload.description: Where to PUT the file's exact bytes, with these headers, before expiresAt

folder.description: Whether the asset was added to the folder named at create
